title: The Model Car Speed Test
question: 把今天“专门制造 -> 达到某个最高速度 -> 纪录看平均速度 -> 先失望 -> 后来发现计时错误”的表达，放进 safe model-car speed test 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Our robotics club entered a safe model-car speed test. Our car had been specially built for the track. It reached a speed that made everyone excited, but the competition used average speed over the whole run. We were disappointed to learn that our result was lower than expected. Later, we were told that a timing mistake had been made.
word_bank: a timing mistake had been made
